introHtml: Popl luggage accessories combine the convenience of NFC technology with your brand messaging, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, and employee onboarding. These slim, durable tags attach to bags or luggage, allowing recipients to tap and instantly access your website or contact info. Choose from finishes like matte or gloss, and decorate with your logo using full-color printing or engraving. Perfect for marketing directors seeking a modern, functional giveaway that drives engagement beyond the event.
